review.headline: Easy 9 km done on plan: 9.00 km at a steady 5:48/km, avg HR 137.
observations: Planned 9 km easy at 5:11-6:13/km; ran 9.00 km in 3130 s at 5:48/km, inside the easy band and close to the 4-week easy average of 5:46/km.
Every km split was 348 s with HR between 135 and 139, showing very even, controlled effort.
Avg HR 137 is at the low end of recent easy runs (138-140), and the efficiency index of 1.26 is in line with the recent easy-run trend.
RPE and athlete note were not logged, so the subjective effort is unknown.
flags: No RPE or note logged for this run, so subjective feel cannot be confirmed.
Weekly volume is far behind plan (25 km of 45 km in week 2 and no runs in week 3 so far), and CTL has dropped from 45 to 34 over the past week.
